decision.summary: No new action: the daily 78k reach remains the correct live position, and there is still no justified management trigger or secondary setup.
decision.rationale: Binance remains bullish short term with expanding open interest and price trading close to the 24h highs, so the existing 78k reach daily is still the right trade to hold. The position is only slightly below breakeven and is not near take-profit or exceptional invalidation. Re-adding is still blocked by the live cash cap, while the next bullish daily at 79k is too weak around 9%. Bearish dailies and weekly dips remain fully out of sync with current execution reality. The cleanest move is to hold the existing daily and do nothing else.
